title: [Docs]: CONTRIBUTING_zh.md has drifted from CONTRIBUTING.md (typo + 3 missing sentences)
body:
﻿## Description

`CONTRIBUTING_zh.md` has drifted from `CONTRIBUTING.md`. Three confirmed gaps plus one typo:

### 1. Typo at CONTRIBUTING_zh.md:34

`所有人的事件都是宝贵的资源` — should be `时间` (time), matching C…
